high_level_description: The image is a meme-style graphic that combines historical figures with a map of Vienna, Austria, from 1913. The map serves as the background, showing the layout of the city with various streets and landmarks. Overlaid on the map are five photographs of historical figures, each labeled with their names: Hitler - Located in the upper right section of the map. Freud - Positioned in the upper left section. Trotsky - Situated in the lower left section. Franz Joseph - Placed in the center-right section.
